Prepare photographs as an experiment project

Source: R/workflow.R
prepare_experiment.Rd

Finds photographs recursively, preserving their relative paths. With a batch/control and batch/treatment folder structure, each batch path proposes a separate set_id and the leaf folder proposes the treatment. Only explicit control folder names are recognized. Other structures produce blank labels for the user to complete. Folder suggestions never confirm experimental identity or QC. One photograph must represent one independent plate; repeated time points of a plate are not independent replicates.

Usage

prepare_experiment(
  input = NULL,
  project_dir = "FunMel_project",
  metadata = NULL,
  control_folders = c("control", "controls"),
  max_uncompressed_mb = 2048
)

Arguments

input

Photograph folder, ZIP, or a photograph inside the intended folder. Selecting a photograph includes all supported images in its containing folder and subfolders, not only that image. For multiple batches, supply the root folder or ZIP. NULL opens a file chooser. Selecting an existing project or analysis RDS beside project.rds reopens it with load_experiment().

project_dir

New output folder; must be empty or not yet exist.

metadata

Optional metadata data frame or CSV path. Otherwise a unique plate_metadata.csv in the input is used, or a template is proposed.

control_folders

Exact folder labels denoting controls (case-insensitive).

max_uncompressed_mb

Maximum total selected ZIP entry size in MB.

Value

A funmel_project with paths to metadata, images, QC and result files.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
project <- prepare_experiment() # Choose a photo ZIP or one photo in its folder.
# Edit project$metadata_file: verify set_id, treatment and centre_model.
result <- run_experiment(project, n_spots = 5, spot_radius_mm = 0.4)
# Inspect project$qc_dir; review reminders do not require approval-flag edits.
reviewed <- finish_experiment(project)
} # }
